_what: Staged video work that survives a stop (video-pipeline.mjs). A pipeline is a row in `pipelines` of named stages. A stage row: `id`, `name` (the words the person sees), `needs` (stage ids that must be done first), `weight` (its share of the run's progress), `retry` ({ max, wait_ms }: the same stage is tried again after a failure that may be retried, as its own recorded attempt), `requires` ({ stage, field, equals }: the stage does not run until that earlier stage's result holds that value, so space is freed only after the server has confirmed what it keeps), `finalize` (a handler name run on the next start when a stop left this stage half done). Handlers are handed in by the caller, so this file names no tool, format or place. A run is a file that is rewritten before and after every stage; stopping at any moment and starting again continues from the first stage that is not done.

pipelines.name: Cut a recording to its best moments
Cut a recording to its best moments and keep the file

words.no_handler: Nothing is set up to do {stage}.
words.interrupted: {stage} was stopped part way and is being finished.
words.part_unconfirmed: {count} of {total} parts are not confirmed yet.
